relationship_to_original_study.upgrade_analyses_role: separately locked comparative and exploratory extension

model_set.weights_status_at_lock: official SharePoint folder identified; not yet downloaded
official SharePoint folder identified; not yet downloaded

model_provenance.training_data_claim: ATLAS R2 public training cohort represented by the repository fold_index.csv
model_provenance.eligibility_gate: all 655 training identifiers must be unique and have zero case-level overlap with all 762 formal evaluation identifiers before comparator inference

inference_contract.fold_probability_aggregation: equal arithmetic mean across five folds
inference_contract.feasibility_run: inference only on v12f0001, v12f0289, and v12f0446; no ground-truth access or effect scoring before the full-run decision

primary_upgrade_estimands: MAPPING_DTK10 minus MAPPING_DEFAULT center-macro lesion-wise F1 in R3_NEW
MAPPING_RESUNET minus MAPPING_DEFAULT center-macro lesion-wise F1 in R3_NEW
comparative_analysis.primary_multiplicity: Holm correction across the two comparator-versus-default R3_NEW tests
secondary_estimands: model-specific R2_TEST minus R3_NEW center-macro lesion-wise F1 gap
pairwise center-macro lesion-wise F1 differences in R2_TEST
case-level Dice, lesion-wise F1, PR-AUC, absolute volume error, and absolute lesion-count error by stratum
SOOP model comparisons reported descriptively only
comparative_analysis.secondary_interpretation: effect estimates and 95% intervals; no architecture superiority claim from secondary tests

predictive_uncertainty_analysis.brain_mask: finite nonzero voxels of the source T1 image in unchanged array-index space
calibration_metrics: class-balanced Brier score with equal lesion and non-lesion weight
10-bin equal-width reliability curve within the brain mask
predictive_uncertainty_analysis.case_uncertainty_score: mean binary entropy among brain-mask voxels with foreground probability >= 0.01
predictive_uncertainty_analysis.quality_association: Spearman correlation between case uncertainty and one minus Dice, overall and by stratum
predictive_uncertainty_analysis.risk_coverage: mean Dice after retaining the lowest-uncertainty 100%, 90%, 80%, 70%, 60%, and 50% of cases; ties resolved by token
predictive_uncertainty_analysis.claim_boundary: predictive confidence and retrospective quality-control utility, not calibrated clinical uncertainty or deployment safety

stop_rules: exclude a comparator before scoring if any official weight file is missing, corrupt, or incompatible with its declared trainer/plans
exclude a comparator before scoring if training/evaluation case overlap is nonzero or cannot be resolved
do not replace an excluded comparator with a model selected after viewing formal outcomes
do not optimize thresholds, postprocessing, subsets, or endpoints after viewing comparator outcomes
report null or adverse comparator results without model removal
